summary.plain: The engineering plan for Mu2e: how the solenoids, tracker and calorimeter were designed to catch a muon turning into an electron.
summary.technical: Fermilab-TM-2594 / Fermilab-DESIGN-2014-1 / arXiv:1501.05241: Mu2e Technical Design Report, submitted in partial fulfillment of DOE CD-2 approval, describing the coherent muon-to-electron conversion search and the production/transport/detector solenoid design.
